instruction: Enable the sidebar by default in LibreOffice Writer and set it to show Properties deck.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling sidebar and setting default deck. Evaluator checks IsSidebarVisible=true and PropertyDeck reference. Two-part configuration.
